name: weak-ecommerce
description: A one-product furniture shop (Harbour Workshop) with sound discoverability and a clear first viewport, but weak orientation: no breadcrumbs on any secondary page, no site search, a product page that ends without related links, a bare 404 page with no way onward, and 41 script tags on the home page.

expected.notes: Category ecommerce with high confidence: Product JSON-LD on /shop, nav words shop/cart/checkout, three prices on home. Roles: product=/shop (nav 'Shop'), blog=/journal, about, contact; pricing is a missing role. breadcrumbs_missing (low, high confidence): no breadcrumb markup or BreadcrumbList on any secondary page. site_search_missing (low): no search field on home. related_links_missing (low, medium confidence): /shop has no related heading and only one internal link in the second half of its content; /journal is a listing (two articles) and is not graded. unhelpful_404 (low): the 404 page has no home link, nav or search; soft_404 passes because the status is a real 404. page_weight_heavy (low, low confidence): home has 41 script tags; only home. Trust passes on the footer 'Returns & refunds' link; the hero lead names shop/order/make; the header 'Shop now' is the CTA on every key page; all sampled links resolve (cart and checkout pages exist).
